news.title: Veo Highlights the Power of Connection at the Special Olympics Unified Football World Cup
news.lede: Veo recently featured a story showcasing how access to live-streamed matches helped supporters around the world stay connected to the Special Olympics Unified Football World Cup, held in Paris from 6 to 11 July. The article, "They Are Footballers", highlights how the partnership between Special Olympics and Veo made it possible for families, friends, and fans around the world to follow the tournament through live streaming and match recordings. By expanding access to the competition, the collaboration helped ensure that athletes' achievements could be celebrated far beyond the stadium.

news.title: Donnarumma calls on Italy supporters after ‘heartbreaking’ summer with no World Cup
news.lede: Gianluigi Donnarumma has rallied the Italy supporters, calling on them to help the Azzurri into a new era under Roberto Mancini after a ‘heartbreaking’ summer that left the squad watching the 2026 World Cup from home: ‘Together, we have to rewrite our history’. The Manchester City stopper and Italy national team captain spoke in-depth to Sky Sport Italia ahead of the upcoming September-October international break, which will see the Azzurri take on Belgium, Turkiye, France and Turkiye again in the Nations League. Donnarumma captained the side that lost to Bosnia and Herzegovina in the 2026 World Cup play-off final at the end of March, which led to a complete overhaul of the Italy national team set-up. Head coach Gennaro Gattuso has been replaced by Euro 2020 winner Mancini, Gianluigi Buffon has also left the delegation, as has FIGC President Gabriele Gravina.

news.title: Lionel Messi set for final national team appearance against Benin on October 6
news.lede: Lionel Messi is set to make one final appearance for Argentina when the former world champions face Benin in a friendly in Buenos Aires on October 6, weeks after announcing his retirement from international football. The 39-year-old will play at River Plate’s Monumental Stadium, where the Argentine Football Association (AFA) has planned a farewell in front of the country’s supporters. Messi has agreed to return for the match after the federation discussed the occasion with head coach Lionel Scaloni. According to AFA President Claudio Tapia, the Federation wanted Messi to have a farewell that reflected his importance to the national team after more than two decades in Argentina colours.

news.lede: James Rodríguez closed the final chapter of his international career this week, retiring from Colombian duty with 131 caps after a 15-year run that began when he was barely old enough to drive. His farewell came days after the 2026 World Cup, where Colombia topped their group ahead of Portugal before falling to Switzerland on penalties in the round of 16. The retirement was not just the end of an era for Los Cafeteros.
